description: Real OBD-II session from the team's Maruti Suzuki Fronx, engine fields only. Timestamps re-based to start at 0 ms. Extracted by demo/simulator/build_data.py.
notes: Stationary session: speed_kmh is 0 in every row (engine idling, car parked).
coolant_c and fuel_level_pct are empty in every row of this session.
battery_v comes from the logged 32-byte packet (ELM327 ATRV), not a CSV column.
There is no GPS in this log; the demo parks the car at a fixed, simulated position.
